name: viewsmax
description: Publish and schedule social posts, track offers with tracked links, report clicks and revenue, and research outlier videos through the ViewsMax MCP server.

interface.longDescription: ViewsMax connects your YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram, and Bluesky accounts so you can draft, schedule, and publish posts from a conversation. Track sponsorships and affiliate offers with a tracked link per placement, see clicks, calls booked, sign-ups, and revenue over time, and research outlier videos that beat their channel's average, with AI breakdowns of why they worked.
defaultPrompt: Schedule my latest video to TikTok and YouTube for Friday at 9am
How did my offers perform over the last 28 days?
Find outlier videos about home espresso from this year
